dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Having a dojo in one's home is akin to placing one's sword on the table. It is a reminder to never be negligent.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: One of the fundamental principles of the Kamisato Art of Tachi Jutsu is to constantly sharpen your mind, as you would a blade.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Since we're both here, would you like to train together?
